title: Shielding MCP Tool: A Secure Execution Framework Using TEE and Automated Trimming
creator: Han R.
normalized_title: shielding mcp tool a secure execution framework using tee and automated trimming
V63_REASON: ShieldMCP protects MCP tool functions that can perform external actions using fine-grained TEEs, code trimming, and secure attested invocation. It assures tool-code authenticity/integrity/confidentiality and functional correctness, but does not revalidate the agent decision premises or authority that selected the action.

title: MCP-AgentBench: Evaluating Real-World Language Agent Performance with MCP-Mediated Tools
creator: Guo Z.
source_title: Proceedings of the Aaai Conference on Artificial Intelligence
normalized_title: mcp agentbench evaluating real world language agent performance with mcp mediated tools
V63_REASON: MCP-AgentBench provides 33 operational MCP servers, 188 tools, 600 queries, and outcome-oriented MCP-Eval for real-world task success. It evaluates tool-mediated agent performance but does not itself preserve, enforce, or restore decision validity across the decision-to-execution boundary.

title: Task-Oriented Communications for Agentic IoT: An LLM-Driven QoS/Security Policy Generation via Dynamic Model Context Protocol
creator: Guo S.
source_title: 2025 17th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Signal Processing Wcsp 2025
normalized_title: task oriented communications for agentic iot an llm driven qos security policy generation via dynamic model context protocol
V63_REASON: Available indexed/web evidence confirms an LLM-driven dynamic MCP approach for QoS/security policy generation in Agentic IoT, but does not expose enough methodological detail to determine whether generated policies are independently validated/enforced at the execution boundary or merely produced for downstream use. Full text is required.
